annotations.text: A second window of Hero, floating like the calculator, centred over the sheet. Enter on a skill, a save pip or an attack opens it filled in; Roll > Dice opens it empty. Enter rolls, Escape closes. Every roll is written to the journal as it lands, so closing never loses one.

Advantage and disadvantage roll two d20s and show both, the kept one ringed in the accent. Conditions on the sheet pre-set the mode and the reason is on the line under the title. Damage and free rolls of anything but a d20 leave the modes out of reach.
